notes: Paper (arXiv:2008.13662) derives 95% CL upper limits on the ALP-photon coupling g_agamma from EHT sub-array polarimetric observations (Day 82 of Johnson et al. 2015) of Sgr A*. Text states limits ~1e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a ~ 1e-19 to 1e-18 eV, with constraint curve spanning 1e-20 to 1e-17 eV (Fig. 1). No numerical table is provided; data points are approximate reconstructions from the text description and Fig. 1 shape (roughly flat ~1e-12 GeV^-1 in the sensitive band set by the ~4 hr observation duration and ~20 min cadence, degrading outside). The analysis assumes a solitonic core + NFW DM profile at the Galactic center (core density ~1e8 GeV/cm^3 near Sgr A*, Eq. 2.12), not a local halo density, so dm_density_assumed is null. There are discontinuous jumps in the actual limit curve (e.g. upward bump near m_a=7.9e-18 eV where TS=21.7 best fit occurs) not captured in the smooth approximation. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
